analysis:
I examined five added Gemma 4 tensor-parallel files under libs/darkbloom-cluster.

Selection.swift (1-166) does split-vocabulary greedy, top-k, gather and exchange through allSum collectives. It handles no secrets, prompts or crypto. Peer ranks are cluster workers; the trust of the reduction transport (QwenTensorParallelReduction) is outside this batch.

ShareProbe.swift (1-81) runs a local throwaway synthetic request inside reduction.locally. The synthetic prompt is derived from indices, not consumer data. Logs (line 28) contain only the rank and a skip reason. An error log word comes from qwenPrefixLogWord, which is not supplied; verify it cannot echo request content. Memory admission and the deadline gate keep it fail-safe. A retire failure throws, which fails the load; this is availability only.

SplitSum.swift (1-172) is an oracle that replaces projections for equality tests. Its columns() function bounds-checks divisibility and range.

Synthetic.swift (1-104) writes a random test checkpoint into a caller-supplied directory. It is test tooling with no production path visible.

VerifiedLoad.swift (1-120) is the most relevant to T-012/T-027 and A-004 (weights integrity). It calls prepareGemma4ResidentSource (manifest/aggregate verification) and computes a storage commitment. It enforces exact plan shapes, unique names, and per-tensor checks of shape, bytes, dtype and read accounting (line ~70), plus a memory gate. The receipt carries verifiedAggregateSHA256/storageCommitmentSHA256, which the doc comment says are compared across ranks before serving. That comparison, and binding the result to coordinator weightHash, is not in this batch. Integration should confirm that the cross-rank receipt comparison happens and that the cluster worker trust boundary (not described in the TB-* definitions) is documented.

I found no concrete regression. The threat model lacks a boundary for multi-Mac tensor-parallel peers exchanging activations and logits (prompt-derived data, A-001). Whether that peer link is encrypted or attested is outside the supplied evidence and needs integration review.
